import json,subprocess,sys
MAIN='submission/main.py'
def run(doc):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',MAIN],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout.decode()
def msg(start,headers,body=b''):
    return (('\r\n'.join([start]+headers)+'\r\n\r\n').encode()+body).hex()
REG={"accounts":[{"id":"alice","default":"sip:alice@lab.test","aliases":["sip:alice@lab.test","sip:desk@lab.test","tel:+12025550100"]}],"peers":[{"id":"edge","mode":"access","accounts":[]}],"ttl_ms":1000,"capacity":10}
def show(n,doc):
    rc,out=run(doc); print(n,rc,out[:500])

# port 5-digit leading zero
w=msg('MESSAGE SIP:bob@LAB.test:05060 SIP/2.0',['From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t','To: <sip:bob@lab.test:5060>','Call-ID: c','CSeq: 1 MESSAGE','Content-Length: 0'])
show('port',{"version":1,"config":REG,"events":[{"t":0,"peer":"edge","auth":"alice","egress":"internal","wire_hex":w}]})
